newsitem.title: EU: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, July 21-Sunday, July 27
newsitem.headline: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, July 21-Sunday, July 27

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
Monday - Most EU institutions closed for Belgian National Day holiday.
BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (Tues-Wed).
BRUSSELS - EU agriculture ministers meet (Tues-Wed).
BRUSSELS - Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy meets European Commission President Santer, attends EU foreign ministers dinner (Tues), meets Commissioner Marin (Wed).
BRUSSELS - European Commission weekly meeting (Wed).
BRUSSELS - European Commission President Santer meets Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima - followed by a joint n/conf (Wed).
BRUSSELS - World Bank and European Commission host Bosnia donors conference (Wed-Thurs).
BRUSSELS - EU budget ministers meet (Thurs).
KUALA LUMPUR - EU presidency, European Commission attend Association of South East Asian Nations regional forum (Sun).
MONDAY, JULY 21
- Most EU institutions closed for Belgian National Day holiday.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Luxembourg Justice Minister Marc Fischbach addresses European Parliament Institutional Committee on judicial and police cooperation, immigration and asylum (1500/1300 GMT)

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Luxembourg Foreign Minister Jacques Poos addresses European Parliament Foreign Affairs Committee on activities in the field of common foreign and security policy - information and consultation (1515/1315 GMT).

LUXEMBOURG (NEW ITEM) - Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini meet Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean-Claude Juncker (1100/0900 GMT); hold joint n/conf at 1445/1245 GMT. Venue: Senningen Castle.
TUESDAY, JULY 22

BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (1000/0800 GMT) (first of two days). Agenda includes debate on an accord with Canada and Russia on leghold traps; public debate on Luxembourg's EU presidency programme; presentation by the European Commission of its "Agenda 2000" proposals on EU enlargement; report from High Representative Carlos Westendorp on the situation in Bosnia; and discussions on the Middle East peace process, negotiations with Jordan and assistance to Albania. Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy attends dinner with the ministers.

BRUSSELS - EU agriculture ministers meet (and Wed). Agenda includes the hop sector; welfare of animals during transport; common agricultural policy (CAP) and rural development; negotiations with third countries on veterinary and plant health equivalency; mad cow disease (BSE).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Papoutsis addresses European Parliament Budgetary Control Committee on budgetary management of tourism policy (0900/0700 GMT).

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy attends European Parliament Foreign Affairs Committee (1030/0830 GMT); meets European Parliament President Jose Maria Gil-Robles (1200/1000 GMT) - followed by news briefing at 1300/1100 GMT; meets European Commission President Santer (1530/1330 GMT); attends dinner with EU foreign ministers (1900/1700 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Liikanen attends European Parliament Budgets Committee debate on the "Agenda 2000" proposals on EU enlargement (1500/1300 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament and Council of Ministers hold conciliation committee to iron out differences over the directive on data protection (1700/1500 GMT).
WEDNESDAY, JULY 23
BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (second of two days).
BRUSSELS - EU agriculture ministers meet (second of two days).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission weekly meeting (1500/1300 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Decision on whether to ban Boeing-McDonnell Douglas merger.
- Action against mad cow disease (BSE).
- The social dimension and the labour market in the information society.
- Directive on part time work agreed by labour and employer groups.
- Establishment of scientific committees.
- Management of preferential tarriffs.
- Labelling of genetically modified products.
- Use of the euro symbol.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer meets Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima - followed by a joint n/conf at 1230/1030 GMT.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - World Bank and European Commission host donors conference to raise money for the reconstruction of Bosnia in 1997 (and Thurs).

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy meets European Commissioner Marin (0845/0645 GMT); meets European Parliament Inter-group President Willy De Clercq; Holds n/conf (time not yet announced) - venue: Hilton Hotel.
THURSDAY, JULY 24
BRUSSELS - EU budget ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Cresson addresses EU Economic and Social Committee Energy Section (1200/1000 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - World Bank and European Commission host donors conference to raise money for the reconstruction of Bosnia in 1997 (second of two days).
FRIDAY, JULY 25
No events scheduled.
SATURDAY, JULY 26
No events scheduled.
SUNDAY, JULY 27
KUALA LUMPUR - EU presidency, European Commission attend Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) regional forum.
